title: Iterated decoding and concatenation
statement: Let $c$ be any function from bit strings to bit strings, let $N$ be a natural number, and let $w$ be a bit string with $|w|\le N$. For each $i=0,\ldots,N-1$, if the second decoded component obtained by applying the second projection $i$ times to $w$ is nonempty, apply $c$ to the first decoded component of that string; concatenate these outputs. This equals the concatenation of the images under $c$ of all words obtained by repeatedly decoding $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ maps bit strings to bit strings
